name: botling.report
description: Report pages for the bots: a skill (the ReportSpec v2 guide) and a command (Botling 2 --render-report spec.json page.html) that renders one, with the rule that tells every bot to use them.

promptSections.text: - A settled result that needs visuals or comparison (status, decision, comparison, results to share) goes into one report page, never into chat: the chat reply carries only a brief conclusion and the link to the page; never paste the report body into chat. Text still being discussed or explained (explanations, how to read a figure, research reasoning, drafts, translations) stays short in chat. The page opens with one sentence that answers the user's question ("You asked X; the answer is Y"); if it cannot, do not publish it: answer in chat. Build every report page (status, decision, investigation, comparison, plan, results, explainer) from a ReportSpec v2 JSON, never hand-written HTML. Each time, before you write a spec, read {{docs}}: it holds the format, the blocks, the templates per report kind and all writing and chart rules, and it can change between reports. Write the spec; run {{command}} spec.json {{artifacts:<english-name>.html}} exactly as quoted (add --slides for a 16:9 deck, --force to replace). It prints one JSON line {ok, errors, warnings, htmlPath, link}: fix each error (it gives a path and a valid example) and the warnings you can, run it again (at most twice), then deliver the page at htmlPath as the results rule says.
